title: Split tangents on rationally connected projective manifolds
exact_target: For a smooth connected rationally connected complex projective X with holomorphic $T_X=V_{1}\oplus V_{2}$, must both summands be integrable and X be biholomorphic to a product whose two factor tangents correspond to the given summands?
